page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6v-c8g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance provides 16 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, ensuring that compute resources are fully dedicated without hyperthreading overhead.

The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per CPU core. Acceleration is delivered via two integrated NVIDIA V100 GPUs, which provide a combined total of 32 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps. Given the dual NVIDIA V100 GPU configuration and dedicated Intel Xeon cores, this server is designed for workloads such as deep learning training, machine learning inference, high-performance computing, and GPU-accelerated data processing.
